findings.summary: The one figure-level legend above panel 1 mixes line keys for panels 1-2 (three iron planes, air-core) with marker keys that appear only in the lower panel (|dB| iron circles, |B_air| dashes). A reader scanning panel 1 sees circle and dash keys with no matching marks in that panel; the mapping is still correct and reaches the reader several panels lower. A reader cost only, not a defect that hides data. Same bytes at docs/figures/iron-core-magnetisation/icm-iron-field-source/west-62751-iron-stray-field.png.

The figure is saved at 6.4 x 7.2 in at 120 dpi (768 x 864 px), below the repository's 14 in / 1400 px full-width published-figure convention used by sibling figures. At the ~900 px reckon column it upscales and its text reads slightly lighter than its neighbours. Legible, but inconsistent with the house canvas.

rubric_items.contrast: Pass. All text is dark on white: black axis and tick labels, a #444 annotation, and the #888 zero rule and leader drawn beneath the data. Nothing renders low-contrast.
rubric_items.data_ink: Pass. The series are thin traces and small markers; no fill, band or shaded background spends ink. Grey is reserved for the air-core reference, the zero rule and the annotation leader; colour names the three iron planes.
rubric_items.decoration: Pass. No gradient, background fill or decorative styling. Panels are despined with no gridlines, and the legend is one frameless figure-level block above the panels.
rubric_items.label_collision: Pass. No label is clipped or overlaps another label or the data. Measured: the outer 3 px on all four canvas edges carry 0 non-white pixels, so nothing is clipped at the border; the legend sits above panel 1 with clear margin; the 'peak +6787 %' annotation sits in open space with a single leader to the blue peak.
rubric_items.legibility: Pass. Three stacked panels read top to bottom: total |B| with and without the iron on the three planes; the iron's share on a symlog y axis with the +6787 % near-edge spike annotated; the iron's contribution at every in-vessel poloidal probe. Axis labels, tick labels and the single figure-level legend are legible at the 768 px render. The symlog x axis gives the near-edge structure real width. The middle panel's symlog y axis carries only four ticks (-10^2, 0, 10^2, 10^4), so intermediate shares are readable in sign and order but not to a precise value; that is a deliberate compromise and the plateau value is carried by the table.
rubric_items.table_form: Pass. Each panel shows a spatial relationship (field versus radial distance; contribution versus probe radius) that a table cannot convey; the probe scatter is naturally a plot.
